v4.6.41 — Run the SAME bot on Alpaca and IBKR at the same time

✨ NEW — one bot, both brokers, simultaneously
• You can now run the same bot (e.g. crypto) on Alpaca AND IBKR at once on the cloud. Each runs as its own independent instance with its own sub-portfolio — they don't collide.
• How: in Alpaca mode, assign keys + tick 'Run on Oracle' for the bot and press ▶. Then switch to IBKR mode, enable cloud IBKR (Tools → IBKR), tick 'Run on Oracle' for the same bot, and press ▶. Both now trade 24/7 on the cloud, side by side.
• Each broker keeps fully separate state, logs and positions on the server, so your Alpaca crypto and IBKR crypto never interfere.

Under the hood: cloud bot instances are now tracked per broker (Alpaca keeps its existing setup untouched; IBKR gets its own isolated space). The app tags every start/stop with the active broker.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
